svg.metadata:
{"type":"flowgraph","mermaid":"flowchart LR
	subgraph Write Path
		W1[persistRecord] --> W2[JSON.stringify]
		W2 --> W3[_findRecord]
		W3 --> W4{exists?}
		W4 -->|Yes| W5[doUpdate]
		W4 -->|No| W6[doCreate]
	end
	subgraph Read Path
		R1[read] --> R2[_findRecord]
		R2 --> R3{row found?}
		R3 -->|Yes| R4[JSON.parse RecordData]
		R3 -->|No| R5[callback undefined]
		R4 --> R6[callback parsed object]
	end
","style":"notebook"}
